quotes.title: Gliese 12
quotes.card: Gliese 12 is a red dwarf star located 39.7 light-years away in the constellation Pisces.
quotes.introduction: It has about 24% the mass and 26% the radius of the Sun, and a temperature of about 3,296 K. It is an inactive star and hosts one known exoplanet.
